facts.fact: The Central Bank of Sudan says it licenses electronic payment system services providers, and it revoked Al-Asjad's licence on review by a technical and legal committee.

systems.system: Financial switch operators (Bright Technologies, Al-Asjad, Nahda, SudaPost)
systems.owner: licensed by Central Bank of Sudan

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Sudan revoked the licence of Al-Asjad Digital and Smart Solutions after review against its published standards, and said it had taken measures to protect customers' rights.

SDN.note: Switch licences granted and then revoked; no switch or wallet stated in service.
Aim to connect fee-collecting bodies is stated only as a purpose of licences; no service in service.
